scripts.router:sample-data: cargo run --release --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p ciclybog-data-pipeline -- data/bogota-network.sample.geojson public/data/bogota-graph.bin
scripts.router:pmtiles-data: node scripts/generate-graph-from-pmtiles.mjs public/data/bogota.pmtiles data/bogota-network.generated.geojson && cargo run --release --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p ciclybog-data-pipeline -- data/bogota-network.generated.geojson public/data/bogota-graph.bin
scripts.router:osm-data: cargo run --release --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p ciclybog-data-pipeline -- data/bogota.osm.pbf public/data/bogota-graph.bin public/data/bogota-cycleways.geojson
scripts.router:inspect: cargo run --release --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p ciclybog-router-core --example inspect_graph -- public/data/bogota-graph.bin
scripts.router:export-geojson: cargo run --release --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p ciclybog-router-core --example export_graph -- public/data/bogota-graph.bin data/bogota-graph.geojson
scripts.geocoder:generate: cargo run --release --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p ciclybog-data-pipeline --bin geocoder -- data/bogota.osm.pbf public/data/bogota-geocoder.json
